method: WAR extracted to reviewer scratch with Windows tar; ZIP central directory parsed (zipdir.js); descriptors read in full; all 594 classes parsed with a dependency-free class-file reader (cls.js) and summarized per method (sum.js, disasm-all.txt); JSPs scanned mechanically (jsp-scan.js); descriptor targets checked for existence (desc-check.js); property keys mapped to consumers (prop-consumers.js). Negative claims carry positive controls. No Stage 1 record, prior pass, checklist or status file was opened.

items.conditions_outcome: legacy/ holds exactly four files: the XPlanner+ WAR, a Russian-language README for local Docker run, docker-compose.yml (MySQL 5.7 + Tomcat 9/JRE 8) and demo-seed.sql. The WAR is the behavior source; the helpers are local run aids.
items.limits: demo-seed.sql deliberately not opened: routing extract classifies it as a prepared fixture, not behavior evidence.

items.surface: WAR entry inventory and trailing-slash entry classification
items.conditions_outcome: 1090 central-directory entries: 964 files, 126 directories (breakdown BD-WAR-TYPES). The five root entries that appeared with a trailing slash in the ACK listing (index.jsp, toggle.js, time.js, overlib.js, xplanner-plus-activity.log) are regular files: their central-directory names have no trailing slash, external attributes 0x81a40000 (regular file, mode 0644), non-zero sizes (1257, 1606, 1801, 43090, 26728 bytes). The slash was an artifact of the reviewer's awk grouping, not of the archive.
evidence: reviewer-scratch/war-entries.txt lines 85, 114-116, 1090 (tar -tf shows no trailing slash)

items.conditions_outcome: Maven artifact net.sf:xplanner-plus version 1.1, built 2011-12-04 with JDK 1.6.0_29; application properties declare version 1.1a4, build date 04/12/2011, revision 426. SystemInfo shows these (build package defaults to "War").

594 compiled classes in 75 packages: legacy com.technoetic.xplanner.* (actions, forms, security, db, domain, tags, export, importer, mail, charts, soap, ical, wiki, file, history, metrics, util) plus newer net.sf.xplanner.* (JPA domain, DAOs, REST, Spring MVC, events), bundled com.sabre.security.jndi, com.tacitknowledge migration overrides, and patched org.apache.struts.upload/org.displaytag classes. No Java source files are shipped (constitution A1).
items.limits: Method bodies are read from bytecode references and constants only; exact branch semantics are inferred.

items.conditions_outcome: 102 jars: Struts 1.2.9, Spring 3.0.5 (+spring-struts, webmvc), Hibernate 3.6.5 + JPA 2.0 + commons-annotations, Liquibase 2.0.1, tk-autopatch 0.7.3, Axis 1.4 (+jaxrpc, saaj, wsdl4j), Jersey 1.1.5 core/server + jersey-spring 1.5 + Jackson 1.7.4, Quartz 1.5.2, Cewolf 1.0 + JFreeChart 1.0.11, iText 1.01, JasperReports 1.0.2, MPXJ 3.0.1, POI 3.5, Betwixt 0.8, Velocity 1.5 and velocity-dep 1.4, JavaMail 1.4.3, jcifs 1.0.1, HSQLDB 2.2.4, MySQL Connector/J 5.1.13, DBCP 1.2.2, c3p0 0.9.0, ehcache 1.2.3, displaytag 1.0, radeox, xstream, sitemesh 2.2.1, p6spy, Jetty 5.1.10, log4j 1.2.15. items.limits: Which duplicate wins depends on container class loading order (unverified).

items.conditions_outcome: Present but not wired: sitemesh (no filter in web.xml), p6spy (spy.properties present; effective driver is com.mysql.jdbc.Driver), DWR (class net.sf.xplanner.dwr.Project exists, no DWR jar/servlet/config), JAX-WS endpoint (sun-jaxws.xml names class net.sf.xplanner.soap.XPlanner which is absent; WSServlet and listener commented out; no JAX-WS runtime jar), XFire context (commented), Jetty (com.technoetic.xplanner.webservers.JettyServer main only), c3p0 (commented properties), TomcatUserImporter/IdGenerator/HsqlServer/XPlannerProperties/PdfExporter main() tools, Quartz scheduler (see background work), CsvExporter (not referenced by any action bean).

items.surface: Local run helpers and the known MySQL configuration patch
items.conditions_outcome: docker-compose runs mysql:5.7 (database/user named for the app, credentials at legacy:docker-compose.yml:16,19,23) and tomcat:9.0-jre8, mounting the WAR read-only as xplanner-legacy.war (context /xplanner-legacy), CATALINA_OPTS heap and -Xverify:none (workaround for Javassist proxy verification), no -Dxplanner.overrides. README states the WAR is v1.1a4 with a patched xplanner-custom.properties switching HSQLDB to MySQL (jdbc:mysql://db/xplanner), schema auto-created on first start, URL /xplanner-plus, and documents a default login pair (location legacy:README.md:38). The compose comment instead attributes the MySQL URL to xplanner.properties; both files carry the same db URL (xplanner.properties:13, xplanner-custom.properties:20). The spring-beans.xml dataSource comment (defaultAutoCommit=false for MySQL) is part of the same patched baseline.
items.limits: Helpers are context, not behavior evidence. Which of the two files carries the "patch" cannot be proven from the package alone; the effective values are identical.

items.conditions_outcome: META-INF/context.xml sets Tomcat path /xplanner-plus and antiJARLocking; geronimo-web.xml context-root /xplanner; sun-web.xml context-root /xplanner-plus with keepgenerated. Under the helper deployment the context is derived from the WAR filename (/xplanner-legacy).
items.limits: Tomcat ignores the path attribute of an embedded context.xml (container semantics, unverified).

items.conditions_outcome: XPlannerActionServlet (Struts 1.2) mapped to /do/*, load-on-startup 2, loads struts-config.xml, mobile-struts-config.xml and test-struts-config.xml as ONE default module; validate=true. Controller is Spring DelegatingTilesRequestProcessor: actions without a type resolve to Spring beans named by path in action-servlet.xml, spring-beans.xml and test-action-servlet.xml (ContextLoaderPlugIn). Tiles plugin loads tiles-definitions.xml. XPlannerActionServlet replaces the Struts message resources with the Spring-backed strutsMessageSource per request. 87 action mappings (breakdown BD-STRUTS-ACTIONS).

com.sun.jersey.spi.spring.container.servlet.SpringServlet mapped to /rest/* with POJO JSON mapping; resources are Spring components found by <context:component-scan base-package="net.sf.xplanner.rest"> (ViewService @Path /view, UpdateService @Path /update, request scope). No security filter is mapped to /rest/*.

AxisServlet mapped to /soap/* and /servlet/AxisServlet; server-config.wsdd deploys RPC service "XPlanner" (class com.technoetic.xplanner.soap.XPlanner, allowedMethods="*") and "Version" (getVersion), bean mappings for ProjectData, IterationData, UserStoryData, TaskData, FeatureData, TimeEntryData, NoteData, PersonData in namespace http://xplanner.org/soap; http transport request flow URLMapper + HTTPAuthHandler; global JWSHandler for .jws/.jwr (no .jws files in WAR); Authenticate handler declared but not used in any chain; attachments directory is a Windows developer path; an adminPassword parameter is present (location only, war:WEB-INF/server-config.wsdd:4). BasicSecurityFilter covers only /soap/*.
items.limits: Axis dispatch through /servlet/AxisServlet without path info is library behavior (unverified).

items.conditions_outcome: iCalServlet mapped to /ical/*, protected by BasicSecurityFilter (session subject or HTTP Basic).

DispatcherServlet "SpringServlet" (load-on-startup 1, contextConfigLocation classpath:spring-web.xml) mapped to /setting/*: component-scan net.sf.xplanner.web, DefaultAnnotationHandlerMapping, InternalResourceViewResolver prefix /WEB-INF/jsp/ suffix .jsp (JstlView), TilesConfigurer with tiles-definitions.xml and tiles-pages.xml. WebSecurityFilter covers /setting/*.

Cewolf CewolfRenderer mapped to /cewolf/* (load-on-startup 1, overliburl ../../../overlib.js, debug false) renders chart images produced by <cewolf:chart> tags in iterationStatistics.jsp and aggregateTimesheet.jsp. No security filter on /cewolf/*.
items.limits: Cewolf stores chart producers per session; whether an image id is retrievable without that session is library behavior (unverified).

items.surface: Static web root and directly reachable JSPs
items.conditions_outcome: Outside WEB-INF the WAR serves index.jsp, calendar/calendar-i18n.jsp (JavaScript calendar labels from message keys), editTimeEntries.js, overlib.js, time.js, toggle.js, calendar/ (15 files), css/ (4), images/ (54), js/ (12: jQuery 1.5.1, jQuery UI 1.8.11, dojo/dojox, swfobject, nifty, tooltip, iteration.js, global.js, chart.html), ui/ (16), flash/ (Dashboard.swf, expressInstall.swf), files/ (peopleImportTemplate.xls, storiesImportTemplate.xls) and a historic xplanner-plus-activity.log (216 lines of 2011 localhost activity records). None of these paths is covered by a security filter (filters cover /do/*, /setting/*, /soap/*, /ical/*).

items.surface: Welcome file, session and distribution settings
items.conditions_outcome: Welcome file index.jsp; HTTP session timeout 30 minutes; <distributable/> declared; JSP property group for *.jsp and *.jspi.

items.surface: Container error pages and error disclosure
items.conditions_outcome: JspException, ServletException and any Throwable forward to /WEB-INF/jsp/common/unexpectedError.jsp, which prints the exception message, toString and full stack trace, filing instructions (error.filingInfo with support email/issue URL), and system information boxes: build info, database info (dialect, driver, driver version, vendor, version, db name, JDBC URL, database user name, password shown masked "******" or "[not set]", patch level text), app server, JVM memory, and system properties (date, time, current directory, Java/JVM versions, OS user name, time zone, OS). Applies to any channel including unauthenticated ones.
items.limits: Runtime behavior not observed (Stage 2 is source-only; live check belongs to Stage 3).

items.conditions_outcome: Mapping order: ActivityLogFilter (/do/*), ServletRequestFilter (/*), OpenSessionInViewFilter (/*, REQUEST+ERROR), HibernateSessionFilter (/*, REQUEST+ERROR, binds the OSIV session to a thread-local and fails if OSIV did not create it), MobileSecurityFilter (/do/mobile/*), WebSecurityFilter (/do/* and /setting/*), BasicSecurityFilter (/soap/* and /ical/*), RequestCharacterEncodingFilter (/do/*, UTF-8). The encoding filter runs after the security filters.
items.limits: Effect of late character-encoding on parameters already read by the security filters is unverified.

items.conditions_outcome: ActivityLogFilter writes a START and an END line per /do request: timestamp, authenticated userId (from session subject) or blank, remote address, action name (URI after /do/), duration and query string. log4j routes this category to ACTIVITY_FILE ${xplanner-plus.root}/xplanner-plus-activity.log (5MB x 50 rolling) and console; webAppRootKey xplanner-plus.root with log4jExposeWebAppRoot=true places the file in the exploded web application root, i.e. inside the static web space.
items.limits: Whether the running container exposes the written file over HTTP depends on unpacked deployment (unverified).

items.conditions_outcome: ServletRequestFilter stores the request in a ThreadLocal (used by SOAP, search predicates, aggregate timesheet authorization) and sets request attributes currentPageUrl (URL + query) and appPath.

Listeners in order: Spring Log4jConfigListener (classpath:log4j-war.xml), HsqldbServerContextListener, Spring ContextLoaderListener (classpath:spring-beans.xml, importing spring-caching.xml, spring-dao.xml, spring-security.xml), RequestContextListener, net.sf.xplanner.context.ContextLoaderListener (puts iterationTypes and appUrl = xplanner.application.url into the servlet context). HsqldbServerContextListener starts an in-process HSQLDB server only when xplanner.migration.databasetype=hsqldb; the effective value is mysql, so it logs and does nothing; its shutdown hook stops a started server.

items.surface: Schema creation and seed data at application startup (Liquibase)
items.conditions_outcome: Bean liquibase (SpringLiquibase, contexts "test, production", changelog classpath:db-changelog.xml) runs before sessionFactory (depends-on) on every start. ChangeSets: 1-1 create 19 tables unless attribute exists; 1-2 keys/indexes (unique person.userId, role.role); 1-3 seed permissions (sysadmin wildcard, negative create.project/create.person for editor, etc.), roles viewer/editor/admin/sysadmin as nested set (lft/rgt 1-8, 2-7, 3-6, 4-5), patches level 14, identifier nextId 19, bootstrap person id 1 userId sysadmin with a seeded password hash (location BD-CREDENTIAL-LOCATIONS) and person_role sysadmin on project 0; 2-1 object_type and setting tables; 2-2 seven object_type rows (User, Setting, ...); 2-3 last_update columns on xdir/xfile; 2-4 project.backlog_id; 2-5 rename table role -> roles. Seeds are guarded by preconditions (MARK_RAN).
items.limits: Changelog applies to MySQL at runtime (unverified).

items.conditions_outcome: xplanner.migration.patchpath names packages patches, com.technoetic.xplanner.upgrade and com.technoetic.xplanner.security.install; BootstrapSystemUser.migrate would create the sysadmin user, roles and permissions via GlobalSessionFactory; tacitknowledge override classes are bundled. No class invokes a migration launcher, the upgrade package and patches directory are absent, and GlobalSessionFactory is only initialized by HibernateHelper (called only from TomcatUserImporter). The path is not executed in this package.
items.limits: Negative established by call-site scan over all 594 classes (positive control: HibernateHelper.initializeHibernate caller found).

items.surface: Hibernate session factory wiring and ignored Hibernate properties
items.conditions_outcome: sessionFactory = AnnotationSessionFactoryBean(dataSource, packagesToScan net.sf.xplanner.domain, mappingLocations classpath:/mappings/Metrics.xml) with no hibernateProperties. Therefore hibernate.dialect (XPlannerMySQLDialect), hibernate.cache.* (EhCache provider, query and second-level cache), hibernate.query.substitutions and hibernate.show_sql from xplanner*.properties have no Hibernate consumer (dialect only displayed by SystemInfo; substitutions only used by the UseBeans JSP tag; show_sql only by HsqlServer). The 16 other hbm files and com.technoetic.xplanner.domain.*2 classes are unreferenced. XPlannerInterceptor (auto lastUpdateTime) is attached only by XPlannerSessionFactory, which the Spring path does not use.
items.limits: Hibernate then auto-detects the dialect from JDBC metadata (library behavior, unverified).

items.conditions_outcome: dataSource = commons-dbcp BasicDataSource with driver, URL, username and password from ${hibernate.connection.*} placeholders (resolved from the XPlannerProperties bean by PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer) and defaultAutoCommit=false; hibernate.dbcp.* pool keys have no consumer. Effective target: MySQL database "xplanner" on host "db".

<tx:annotation-driven> with HibernateTransactionManager; BaseDao save/delete REQUIRED and reads readOnly; AbstractAction.execute runs doExecute and beforeObjectCommit inside CheckedExceptionHandlingTransactionTemplate (TransactionTemplate) and calls afterObjectCommit afterwards; several actions and SOAP additionally flush and commit/rollback the JDBC connection directly (FileManager, Integration, MoveContinueTask, ContinueUnfinishedStories, UpdateTimeNotificationReceivers, XPlannerLoginModule.changePassword, SOAP commit/rollback).

XPlannerProperties loads classpath xplanner.properties, then overlays the file named by system property xplanner.overrides (default xplanner-custom.properties) key by key; missing base file logs "Can't load xplanner.properties!!!". The seven other xplanner-custom-*.properties files are inert unless selected by -Dxplanner.overrides (not set by the helpers). The properties object is a Spring bean and the source for ${...} placeholders. Values can be changed at runtime by setProperty/removeProperty (see /do/edit/properties).

Effective from xplanner-custom.properties:19-24 (overriding identical base values): MySQL dialect class name, jdbc:mysql://db/xplanner, empty dbname, com.mysql.jdbc.Driver, database login pair (location only). Consumers: dataSource placeholders, SystemInfo (display, password masked), HsqlServer (URL pattern check). xplanner.migration.databasetype=mysql consumed by HsqldbServerContextListener.

Effective xplanner.application.url = http://localhost:8080/xplanner (xplanner-custom.properties:30 overrides base :138 /xplanner-plus), which matches neither /xplanner-plus nor the helper context /xplanner-legacy. Consumers: net.sf.xplanner ContextLoaderListener -> servlet-context appUrl, used by baseHeader.jsp for the personal status link ${appUrl}/setting/me/status/{personId}; EmailFormatterImpl for the email host URL and for fetching ${url}/css/email.css over HTTP. IntegrationEmailNotifier builds links from the request instead.
items.limits: Resulting broken links/CSS fetch are inferred, not observed.

items.conditions_outcome: SMTP host localhost, port 25 (base :78-79; custom overrides commented), sender xplanner@xplannerplus.org, integration CC empty; optional xplanner.mail.smtp.user/password (commented placeholders) enable SMTP AUTH + STARTTLS via SmtpAuthenticator when present. Consumer: EmailMessageImpl constructor (javax.mail Session.getDefaultInstance).

Only xplanner.security.login[0] (XPlannerLoginModule, name XPlanner, userIdCaseSensitive=true) is active; JNDI/LDAP login[1] and NTLM login[2] are commented. LoginModuleLoader reads login[N].module/name/option.* sequentially, instantiates modules through Spring LoginModuleFactory beans, and fails with serverConfigurationError.noModuleName if a module has no name.

twiki.scheme.* URL schemes (sourceforge, cvs, jira, wiki) and handlers (project/iteration/story/task -> DomainObjectSchemeHandler; cq -> PropertySimpleSchemeHandler reading xplanner.scr.scheme.url); twiki.wikiadapter=GenericWikiAdapter with existing/new topic URLs on localhost:9090 and a "new topic" pattern. Consumers: TwikiTag, TwikiFormat, GenericWikiAdapter; per-project override of twiki.scheme.wiki stored as a project attribute (EditProjectAction, DomainSpecificProperties).

items.surface: Feature and display settings with consumers
items.conditions_outcome: progressbar html (ProgressBarDelegatorTag, iteration.jsp, userstory.jsp); xplanner.statistics on (globalLinks.jsp); effort chart flags burndown/progress displayed, velocity notDisplayed, 800x400, include weekends (iterationStatistics.jsp); export formats xml,mpx,mspdi,pdf,jrpdf (exportLinks.jsp); story default priority 4 (UserStoryEditorForm); search.content.globalScopeEnable=true (ContentSearchAction, NavigationBarTag); iteration.automatically.extend.endDate=false (DataSamplerImpl); xplanner.project.send.notification=true default (EmailNotificationSupport, EditProjectAction); integration listeners IntegrationEmailNotifier (IntegrationAction.init); spreadsheet import headers and completed status "C" (ImportStoriesAction); login.instructions.url (login.jsp); error.filingInfo/support.* (unexpectedError.jsp); displaytag export.* labels.

42 of 106 effective keys have no consumer found: all actionbuttons.* (file comment says "Verify that nobody uses these"), hibernate.cache.*, hibernate.dbcp.*, org.quartz.* (no scheduler factory), xplanner.test.user/password/property. xplanner.scr.scheme.url is consumed indirectly (named inside the value of twiki.scheme.cq.handler).
items.limits: Exact-string and prefix scan; reflective or computed key names could be missed (positive controls: login.instructions.url found in login.jsp, xplanner.progressbar.impl found in three consumers).

items.surface: Credential material shipped in configuration and code (locations only)
items.conditions_outcome: Active database login pair in two property files, test login pair, Axis administration password parameter, commented/placeholder pairs, seeded bootstrap password hash in the Liquibase changelog, hash/password literals in two classes, and helper credentials in README/docker-compose. Values are not reproduced in this evidence.

Message bundles ResourceBundle (default, 874 lines) and da, de, es, fr, it, ja, pt_br, ru; ResourceBundle--.properties cannot be selected by locale (inert); EmailResourceBundle for notification texts. Spring ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource (UTF-8, no system-locale fallback) backs Struts messages via XPlannerMessageResources (bean: prefix translation). Session locale set by /do/changeLocale; date/time formats from keys format.date/format.datetime.

log4j-war.xml: console appenders (WARN, DEBUG, ALL), FILE rolling appender ${xplanner-plus.root}/xplanner-plus.log defined but not referenced by root; ACTIVITY_FILE for ActivityLogFilter; root INFO to console. SystemInfo logs an "XPLANNER INFO" block at startup (setServletContext). The JSP error page logs the exception under the request URI.

A shared HashMap (resultByArgsByMethodName) caches AuthorizerQueryHelper.getAllPermissions/getAllPermissionsToPerson and PrincipalSpecificPermissionHelper.getPermissionsForPrincipal per argument list (MethodCacheInterceptor); entries are invalidated after Authenticator.logout (argument index 1) and after EditPersonHelper.modifyRoles (any person argument); /do/invalidateCache clears the whole map. ehcache.xml defines only a default cache (10000 elements, 120 s). Queries in tags/DAOs set cacheable although Hibernate cache properties are not delivered (see Hibernate wiring item).

AuthenticationAction with DynaActionForm (userId, password, action, loginModuleNames). If userId empty -> forward notAuthenticated (login.jsp). Otherwise Authenticator.authenticate: an already authenticated session is logged out first; LoginContext tries each configured module in order, collecting per-module error messages. Success: subject and LOGIN_CONTEXT stored in session; if parameter remember=Y the credential cookie is set; redirect to the saved URL or forward authenticated (redirect /do/view/projects). Failure: global message login.failed plus per-module messages (moduleMessages) and login.jsp. login.jsp shows remember-me checked by default, optional login instructions link (login.instructions.url) and iterates available login module names.
items.limits: Runtime behavior not observed (Stage 2 is source-only; live check belongs to Stage 3).

items.conditions_outcome: Looks up Person by userid (parameterized HQL); unknown user -> userNotFound; Hibernate error -> storageError; empty stored password -> passwordNotSet; stored value is Base64 of salt+MD5(salt+password, UTF8); mismatch -> authenticationFailed. userIdCaseSensitive option read by SecurityHelper.isAuthenticationCaseSensitive. Logout invalidates the HTTP session.

CredentialCookie writes cookie "userid" (plain) and cookie "password" (Base64 of the clear password, reversible) with maxAge Integer.MAX_VALUE and no secure/HttpOnly setting; FormSecurityFilter re-authenticates from these cookies when no session subject exists; on failure (or on unauthenticated access with cookies present) the cookies are deleted; logout deletes them.

items.surface: Form security filter semantics (web and mobile)
items.conditions_outcome: AbstractSecurityFilter treats every request under its mappings as secure unless it matches a <security-bypass> pattern; unauthenticated secure requests: remove stale credential cookies, save the URL for GET requests, redirect to contextPath + authenticatorUrl. security.xml bypasses /do/login, /do/notAuthorized and /do/invalidateHibernateCache; mobile-security.xml bypasses /do/mobile/login and /do/mobile/notAuthorized. The <security-constraint>/<auth-constraint> role lists in security.xml, mobile-security.xml and soap-security.xml are parsed by Digester but never evaluated: SecurityConfiguration.isAuthorized has no caller, so these files only enforce "authenticated" (role names viewer/editor/admin, and "*" in most constraints, have no effect).
items.limits: Absence of callers checked across all classes (positive control: SecurityConfiguration.load callers found).

items.surface: Mobile login reachable only after web login
items.conditions_outcome: /do/mobile/* is mapped to both MobileSecurityFilter and WebSecurityFilter (/do/*). /do/mobile/login is bypassed only in mobile-security.xml, so WebSecurityFilter redirects an unauthenticated mobile visitor to /do/login.
items.limits: Runtime behavior not observed (Stage 2 is source-only; live check belongs to Stage 3).

items.surface: HTTP Basic authentication for SOAP and iCal
items.conditions_outcome: BasicSecurityFilter: authenticated session subject passes; otherwise Authorization "Basic " header is Base64-decoded and split at ":" and passed to the same Authenticator (subject stored in session); failure logs "basic authentication failed" and responds 401 with WWW-Authenticate Basic realm="XPlanner". soap-security.xml has no bypass, so every /soap/* and /ical/* request requires authentication.

LogoutAction: Authenticator.logout for the remote user (login module invalidates the session; permission cache entries for the user invalidated by advisor), deletes remember-me cookies, forwards security/login (-> /do/login).

When the person editor submits a non-empty newPassword (and matching confirmation per PersonEditorForm), EditPersonAction.afterObjectCommit calls the current session's login module changePassword(userId, newPassword); XPlannerLoginModule stores a new salted MD5 hash and commits the JDBC connection; AuthenticationException -> ServletException. JNDI, NTLM and JAAS modules throw UnsupportedOperationException.

Beans exist for JNDI/LDAP (com.sabre JNDIAuthenticatorImpl: anonymous/fixed-user/user bind, search or pattern lookup, password compare with optional digest, role search), NTLM (jcifs SmbSession.logon against a domain controller; default domain literal when not configured), and JAAS adapter (configurable LoginModule/principal classes). Each then maps the principal to an existing XPlanner Person (userNotFound otherwise).
items.limits: Not active in the effective configuration.

items.conditions_outcome: The first start seeds person id 1 with userId sysadmin, name sysadmin, initials SYS, email no@reply.com, a stored password hash, and role sysadmin on project 0 (all projects). The README documents a default login for it (location only). Disabled NullSecurityFilter (commented in web.xml) would auto-login as defaultUserId sysadmin.

Roles viewer < editor < admin < sysadmin as a nested set (roles.lft/rgt); person_role(person, project, role) with project 0 meaning every project; permission(principal=role or person, name, resource_type, resource_id, positive). Named queries security.roles, security.role.permissions (a role inherits positive permissions of weaker roles), security.personal.permissions, security.person.permissions. AuthorizerImpl maps object classes to resource types system.project, .iteration, .story, .task, .feature, .time_entry, system.project.integration, system.person, system.note, system.setting; matches names with % wildcards, honors negative permissions, resolves per-principal maps with caching.

Authorizer.hasPermission* is called only in: DispatchForward.execute (read on system.project, projectId required), EditPersonHelper.isCurrentUserAdminOfProject and EditRoleAction.isAuthorizedRoleAdministratorForProject (admin.edit.role), SearchResultAuthorizationPredicate (read), AggregateTimesheetQuery (read per project row), IterationRepository.canUserEditIteration and UserStoryRepository.accept (edit), iCalServlet (admin.edit on system.person for another user's calendar), SOAP XPlanner (read/edit/delete/create), OutlineTag.verifyProjectAccess (read), PermissionHelper.isProjectAccessibleByPerson, and JSP tags via AuthorizationHelper. The secure repository chain (RepositorySecurityAdapter via secureObjectRepositoryFactory/metaRepository) is used only by IntegrationEmailNotifier. Struts view/edit/delete/export/move/continue/time/note/file actions read and write through CommonDao without an object-level permission check; access control there is limited to authentication plus render-time tags.
items.limits: Direct-request authorization gaps are inferred from bytecode; they are not demonstrated live.

items.conditions_outcome: DispatchForward forwards to the forward named by the mapping parameter; when authorization is required (default true, or forward "@secure" true) it needs request projectId (missing -> "no project identifier supplied" and security/notAuthorized) and read permission on that project (else security/notAuthorized); missing forward -> error forward with action.missing.parameter. Spring beans set authorizationRequired=false for /view/twikiformat, /view/projects, /view/people, /view/settings, /view/dashboard and /notAuthorized; /view/integrations and all six mobile view actions (Struts-instantiated) require projectId+read.

Global exceptions: ObjectNotFoundException and Hibernate UnresolvableObjectException -> generalError.jsp with error.objectNotFound; AuthorizationException -> generalError.jsp with security.notauthorized. The security/notAuthorized forward target /WEB-INF/jsp/security/notAuthorized.jsp does not exist in the WAR (only login.jsp in jsp/security).
items.limits: Container response for a forward to a missing JSP (404/500) unverified.

items.conditions_outcome: xplanner:isUserAuthorized (resource type/id or object, permission, projectId from context or request), isUserAuthorizedForAny (permissions over a project collection), isUserInRole (role names or userId match) and authenticatedUser guard edit/delete/admin links and sections in 19 JSPs (tag lines per file in BD-JSP), e.g. editPerson.jsp, editRoles.jsp, people.jsp, project.jsp, userstory.jsp, task.jsp, integrations.jsp.

GET /do/view/projects (DispatchForward, no project check) -> projects.jsp: displaytag table of projects ordered by hidden flag and name, hidden rows styled, create/edit/delete links gated by render-time tags; export options. index.jsp (unauthenticated) queries non-hidden projects and redirects to /do/view/projects, or to the current iteration when exactly one project has one.

/do/view/project and /do/view/project/features (ViewObjectAction type Project, oid) load the project into the domain context and forward to project.jsp / projectFeatures.jsp (iterations list, notes, twiki description, links gated by tags). Invalid/unknown oid -> NumberFormatException or object-not-found handling.

/do/edit/project (ProjectEditorForm; validation project.editor.missing_name unless the action is add/del time notification). Update loads by oid and populates; Create instantiates Project. Saves project attributes: wiki URL (twiki.scheme.wiki, stored only when different from the global value), send-missing-time-entry-reminder flag, escape-brackets option. Actions addTimeNotification/delTimeNotification redirect to /do/edit/project/notification. Publishes create/update events; returns to returnto or view/projects.

/do/edit/project/notification (UpdateTimeNotificationReceivers): addTimeNotification adds personToAddId (non-zero) to project notification receivers; delTimeNotification removes personToDelete; unknown action -> ServletException; errors roll back the connection. Receivers are the project leads for the missing-time-entry report.

/do/delete/project?oid= (DeleteObjectAction type Project): loads, publishes delete event with logged-in user, CommonDao.delete. JPA cascades: Project.iterations ALL -> Iteration.userStories REMOVE -> UserStory.tasks REMOVE -> Task.timeEntries REMOVE; Project.backlog REMOVE. Notes, attributes, history, data samples, notification receivers join rows and role associations referencing the project are not cascaded by mapping. Redirects to returnto or view/projects. No server-side delete permission check.
items.limits: FK constraint behavior for non-cascaded rows depends on the database schema (unverified).

items.conditions_outcome: /do/export/project/{xml,mpx,mspdi} and /do/export/iteration/{xml,mpx,mspdi,pdf,jrpdf}, /do/export/userstory/{pdf,jrpdf}, /do/export/task/{pdf,jrpdf}, /do/export/person/jrpdf (ExportAction + exporter bean): load object by oid, exporter.export(session, object) -> bytes written with exporter headers (inline filenames export.xml, export.mpx, export.pdf, report.pdf). XmlExporter (Betwixt) hides password, lastUpdateTime, personId, id and currentIteration; MPX/MSPDI (MPXJ) include all persons as resources and time entries; PdfExporter renders story/task cards (iText); PdfReportExporter loads JasperReports templates com/technoetic/xplanner/export/reports/*.jrxml which are absent from the WAR -> "Could not open compiled report" ExportException. Exceptions roll back and propagate.
items.limits: Missing jrxml established by listing WEB-INF/classes/com/technoetic/xplanner/export (positive control: velocity .vm templates found by the same search).

items.conditions_outcome: /do/view/iteration, /view/iteration/tasks, /view/iteration/features, /view/iteration/statistics (charts), /view/iteration/accuracy (ViewObjectAction type Iteration) and /view/iteration/metrics (ViewIterationMetricsAction: IterationMetrics.analyze for oid, request attribute metrics). /do/view/iterationTabs forwards to /WEB-INF/jsp/view/iterationTabs.jsp, which is absent. Global forward view/iteration/statistics points to missing iterationIterations.jsp (the action-local forward uses existing iterationStatistics.jsp).

/do/edit/iteration (IterationEditorForm: missing name, bad start date, bad end date / non-positive interval). On Create sets project from form projectId, initial iteration status and daysWorked; exceptions -> ServletException. Update/Create via EditObjectAction mechanics.

/do/start/iteration (IterationStatusEditorForm, request scope): without confirmation shows editIterationStatus.jsp with the number of already started iterations of the project; on confirm optionally closes other started iterations (closeIterations) and starts this one (Iteration.start), generates opening data samples, records history "started"; can hand off to /do/edit/time (wizard/saveTime) to update estimates before starting, coming back via from_edit/time.

/do/close/iteration: loads by oid; if active sets status closed, generates closing data samples, records history "closed", saves; redirects to forward onclose (/do/continue/unfinished/stories) with iterationId, or returnto.

/do/continue/unfinished/stories (ContinueUnfinishedStoriesForm; validation iteration.status.editor.continue_in_same_iteration when target equals source): on Ok continues every incomplete story of the iteration into the target iteration (StoryContinuer clones story with remaining hours and disposition, continues unfinished tasks and notes, appends continued-from/to descriptions and history "continued") and sets the source iteration status inactive; otherwise shows the form; errors roll back.

/do/delete/iteration (DeleteObjectAction type Iteration; mapping names undefined form bean iterationEditorForm): deletes iteration; cascades to stories, tasks, time entries; notes/history/data samples not cascaded.

/do/import/stories (ImportStoriesForm; errors no_import_file, worksheet_name, no_title_column, no_end_date_column, no_priority_column, no_completed_story_status): reads the uploaded workbook (POI) with configurable worksheet and column headers (defaults from properties, remembered in cookies), optionally only incomplete stories, creates stories in the iteration (type Iteration); exceptions WrongImportFile/MissingField/MissingColumnHeader/MissingWorksheet map to import.status.* messages on stories.jsp. Template files/storiesImportTemplate.xls is downloadable.

/do/edit/reorderstories (ReorderStoriesForm: each order number must parse as a number, else story.editor.invalid.order.number): builds story id -> new order array and Iteration.modifyStoryOrder; redirects to /do/view/iteration?oid=.

items.surface: Move several stories to another iteration
items.conditions_outcome: /do/move/userstories (MoveStoriesForm): for each selected story id moves it from iteration to target iteration (history moved out/in), reorders target stories, redirects to /do/view/iteration?oid=.

/do/view/feature, /do/edit/feature and /do/delete/feature are configured with type net.sf.xplanner.domain.Feature, a class that does not exist (only com.technoetic.xplanner.domain.Feature exists, mapped only by the unreferenced Feature.xml). FeatureEditorForm validates feature.editor.missing_name. OutlineTag and navigation still reference features.

items.surface: View, create and edit user story
items.conditions_outcome: /do/view/userstory (ViewObjectAction) and /do/edit/userstory (EditStoryAction, UserStoryEditorForm: missing name, negative estimated hours, invalid priority (non-integer), same iteration for merge; default priority from xplanner.story.defaultpriority). Create/update assigns the iteration, appends to the iteration order and rebuilds order numbers; populateForm computes the new story disposition from the iteration state and the order number.

items.surface: Move or continue a user story
items.conditions_outcome: /do/move/continue/userstory (MoveContinueStoryForm: missing name, same iteration): action Move -> UserStory.moveTo target iteration, order number by target start date, history moved/moved out/moved in; action Continue -> StoryContinuer (clone, continued tasks and notes, descriptions, history continued); unknown action -> ServletException; source iteration reordered; futureIteration flag for the form.
/do/delete/userstory (DeleteObjectAction type UserStory; undefined form bean userStoryEditorForm): deletes story, cascading to tasks and time entries.

items.surface: View, create and edit task with email notification
items.conditions_outcome: /do/view/task and /do/edit/task (EditTaskAction, TaskEditorForm: bad created date format, missing name, negative estimated hours). Create requires userStoryId (fkey); disposition from iteration state. After a successful create or update redirect, sends an HTML email (Velocity templates email_notification_task_created.vm / _updated.vm, subjects task.created.subject / task.updated.subject) to the task acceptor when the acceptor is not the current user, including old/new assignee ("Unassigned"), creator and task.

/do/move/continue/task (session-scoped MoveContinueTaskForm: missing name, same story): Continue -> TaskContinuer into target story (remaining hours become estimate, time entries not copied, created date reset, history); Move -> reassign to target story with history task.moved.from.to / moved out / moved in and disposition from the target story/iteration; unknown action -> ServletException; flush and commit; errors roll back.

/do/edit/task/estimate is bound to the base org.apache.struts.action.Action (returns no forward) and names an undefined form bean; editTaskEstimate.jsp exists and is referenced by a global forward marked "DEBT Do we need this forward?". Re-estimation is performed through /do/edit/time UPDATE_ESTIMATE.
items.limits: Blank response is inferred from Struts semantics.

items.conditions_outcome: /do/delete/task (DeleteObjectAction type Task, form edit/task): deletes task and its time entries (REMOVE cascade).

items.surface: Enter, edit and delete time entries; update estimate
items.conditions_outcome: /do/edit/time (UpdateTimeAction with TaskDao; TimeEditorForm validation: unparsable time/number, missing time, missing person, same people, negative interval, overlapping interval, both interval and duration, missing report date, long description). UPDATE_TIME: for each row delete (deleted=true), edit or create TimeEntry with start/end or duration, person1/person2 (pair), report date, description; first effort starts the task; remaining hours update the estimate. UPDATE_ESTIMATE: records history "reestimated" (Estimate changed from x to y) and sets estimated hours. Before an iteration is started the form is stored in session and control goes to /do/start/iteration (wizard); errors roll back and return to the editor; success redirects to /do/view/task or returnto.

/do/edit/note (EditNoteAction with virtualFileSystem; NoteEditorForm: missing subject, author, body unless a file is attached): optional multipart upload stored as xfile BLOB under virtual directory /attachments/project/{projectId}; note attached to an object id. /do/delete/note (DeleteNoteAction): publishes delete event and NoteHelper.deleteNote (deletes the file when no other note references it). /do/download/attachment?oid= (DownloadAttachmentAction): loads note (HQL "where id=" + parsed int), streams the BLOB with the stored content type and Content-disposition filename; non-numeric oid logged. No object-level permission checks.

/do/view/directory (FileManagerAction, form view/file): actions list (default, root directory), upload (FormFile into directory), download (stream file), delete (file), mkdir, rmdir (then show parent); ObjectNotFoundException -> error/objectNotFound; flush and commit, rollback on error; directory.jsp. The fileSystem dependency is not injected for this bean (see Spring wiring item).

/do/view/people (DispatchForward, no project check; people.jsp with db:useBeans and tags) and /do/view/person (ViewPersonAction, authorizationRequired=false): current active/pending/completed tasks, future tasks, stories as customer and as tracker for the person oid.

items.surface: Create or edit person, roles and sysadmin flag
items.conditions_outcome: /do/edit/person (PersonEditorForm: missing name, userId, email, initials; password mismatch). DuplicateUserIdException -> person.editor.userid_exist on editPerson.jsp. beforeObjectCommit: for each project role in the form, only when the current user has admin.edit.role on that project, replace the person's role on that project; sysadmin role removed/added only when the current user has admin.edit.role on project 0. afterObjectCommit: optional password change. The Struts action itself does not restrict which person may be edited.

/do/delete/person (DeleteObjectAction type Person) deletes the person row via CommonDao; tasks (acceptorId), time entries (person1Id/person2Id), stories (customer/tracker), person_role and personal permissions are not cascaded by mapping. PersonHibernateObjectRepository.delete (which also deletes permissions by resource_id) is not on this path.

items.surface: Import people from a text file
items.conditions_outcome: /do/import/people (ImportPeopleForm): reads the uploaded file line by line, splits by comma into exactly 5 fields (userId, name, email, initials, phone); per line result wrong_entry_format, empty_userId, userId_exists (DuplicateUserIdException from PersonDao.save) or success; each person saved in its own transaction; AuthorizationException -> security/notAuthorized. Imported people have no password. Template files/peopleImportTemplate.xls is downloadable. The personDao dependency is not wired (see Spring wiring item), so saving is expected to fail.

/do/edit/roles (session-scoped RoleEditorForm, type Project; no validation): for each listed person, when the current user has admin.edit.role on the project, delete the person's role associations on the project and insert the selected role (roles looked up by name); editRoles.jsp lists people via db:useBeans.

/do/view/timesheet (PersonTimesheetForm: unparsable start/end date -> timesheet.error.unparsable_date; defaults to current week): PersonTimesheetQuery runs parameterized raw JDBC SQL summing time_entry durations per project/iteration/story for the selected personId and date range plus daily totals; no permission check on personId; timesheet.jsp and Cewolf charts.

/do/view/aggregateTimesheet (AggregateTimesheetForm with date validation): lists all non-hidden people; for the selected people ids and date range runs an HQL aggregate over projects/iterations/stories/time entries; rows are kept only for projects the current user can read; three Cewolf charts (project, iteration, story).

/do/view/integrations (DispatchForward, projectId + read) and /do/edit/integrations (IntegrationAction, placeHolderForm): join (personId required, else integrations.error.noperson; comment; becomes active immediately when no integration is active/pending), leave (action.leave<oid> deletes the entry and notifies the next when it was first), start (error integrations.error.alreadyactive), finish and cancel (terminate active, record completion time, notify next unless nonotify). Listeners from xplanner.integration.listeners (IntegrationEmailNotifier emails the next person with a link to /do/view/integrations?projectId=). Flush/commit; errors roll back.

/do/view/history (ViewObjectAction with no configured type): the object type comes from request parameter @type (Class.forName) and oid; history.jsp lists events for the object or, with container=true, created/deleted events of contained objects (HistorySupport.getEvents/getContainerEvents).

/do/search/id?searchedId= (IdSearchAction with idSearchHelper): empty -> idsearch.error.missingId; non-integer -> idsearch.error.badId; not found -> idsearch.error.idNotFound; found -> redirect /do/view/{type}?oid={id}.

/do/search/content?searchedContent=&restrictToProjectId= (ContentSearchAction): empty -> exception "missing content"/contentsearch.invalid_id; searches names/descriptions of projects, iterations, stories, tasks and notes with named queries *SearchQuery (or *RestrictedSearchQuery for one project when global scope disabled or a project is given) using LIKE %term% parameters; results filtered by read permission; a numeric term also adds an id match; searchResults.jsp.

/do/view/dashboard (dashboard.jsp, integration-related page with navigation by iterationId) and /do/view/settings (settings.jsp listing settings via db:useBeans) are DispatchForward without project check. /do/edit/setting edits a Setting entity (single-table inheritance, object_type) through EditObjectAction using ProjectEditorForm; its input page editSetting.jsp is absent.
/do/view/twikiformat (DispatchForward, no check) -> twikiformat.jsp (static formatting reference); formattingHelpLink/JS fragments open it from editors.
/do/changeLocale?language=&returnto= (ChangeLocaleAction): sets session Struts locale to new Locale(language) or the JVM default when empty; redirects to returnto or forwards view/projects.

/do/systemInfo (SystemInfoAction) sets isSystemInfo and forwards to unexpectedError.jsp in system-info mode (title system.info.title) showing build, database (URL, user, masked password), app server, memory and system properties. Any authenticated user can open it.
/do/admin/reload-tiles (Struts ReloadDefinitionsAction) reloads Tiles definitions for any authenticated user.

items.surface: Test/administration actions loaded in production configuration
items.conditions_outcome: test-struts-config.xml and test-action-servlet.xml are loaded by web.xml and the ContextLoaderPlugIn: /do/edit/dataSample (CommandExecutorAction -> transactional data sampling for due iterations), /do/edit/missingTimeEntryNotification (runs the missing-time-entry email job now), /do/edit/putTheClockForward?dayOffset= (shifts the global TimeGenerator by days; non-numeric resets), /do/edit/properties?propertyName=&propertyValue= (EditPropertiesAction sets in-memory application properties, affecting all users until restart), /do/invalidateCache (clears the permission cache; logs an error if two Authorizers exist) and /do/invalidateHibernateCache (SessionFactory.evictQueries). All redirect to returnto or view/projects; invalidate actions name an absent input JSP. All require authentication except /do/invalidateHibernateCache, which is in the security bypass list.

EditObjectAction: if form submitted -> saveForm (action Update loads by oid and publishes update event; Create instantiates the configured type, saves, sets form id, publishes create event; other action -> ServletException "Unknown editor action"), set cookies, redirect to returnto or forward view/projects; else populateForm from the object for display. populateObject copies form properties onto the entity; with request parameter merge=true it also applies Struts RequestUtils.populate(entity, request), copying arbitrary request parameters onto the persistent object; many-to-one ids resolved through RelationshipMappingRegistry. Domain events are published to Spring (see events item).

DeleteObjectAction: type from the Spring property, else forward "@type", else request parameter @type (Class.forName); loads by oid, publishes delete event with the logged-in person, CommonDao.delete, redirects to returnto or view/projects. Non-numeric oid -> NumberFormatException (error page).

EventManager publishes ObjectCreated, ObjectUpdated and ObjectDeleted Spring application events for editor and delete actions. The only listener class, net.sf.xplanner.email.EmailPerChangeListener, is not declared as a bean and not in a component-scan package, so the events have no consumer.

HistorySupport.saveEvent stores History rows (object type, target id, container id, person, action, description, time); repeated "updated" events for the same target within a short interval are throttled. Written by start/close iteration, move/continue story and task, re-estimate, SOAP updates and the repository history adapter. Generic Struts create/update/delete through CommonDao write no history row.

items.surface: Domain context, navigation bar and outline
items.conditions_outcome: AbstractAction.setDomainContext builds the project/iteration/story/task/feature breadcrumb from the loaded object (or projectId parameter) and stores it in the request; NavigationBarTag renders top/back links (back via returnto or history.back) and loads objects by oid/fkey; OutlineTag renders the outline with previous/next siblings filtered to readable projects; WEB-INF/tags/breadcrumb.tag renders breadcrumbs.

Tiles definitions tiles:default (defaultLayout.jsp with header/footer), tiles:view (viewLayout.jsp, screen mode), tiles:print (print mode without header/footer), tiles:edit (defaultEditLayout.jsp) and viewLayout (viewLayoutNew.jsp, tiles-pages.xml for Spring MVC). ContentTag switches to tiles:print when print mode is requested.

items.surface: Descriptor targets that do not exist
items.conditions_outcome: Missing JSPs referenced by configuration: /WEB-INF/jsp/security/notAuthorized.jsp (global forward and /notAuthorized), /WEB-INF/jsp/view/iterationTabs.jsp, /WEB-INF/jsp/view/iterationIterations.jsp, /WEB-INF/jsp/view/taskhistory.jsp, /WEB-INF/jsp/view/viewtext.jsp, /WEB-INF/jsp/edit/editSetting.jsp, /WEB-INF/jsp/admin/invalidateCache.jsp. Undefined form-bean names: iterationEditorForm, featureEditorForm, userStoryEditorForm, edit/task/estimate, edit/properties, and name "/download/attachment". Missing Spring type value net.sf.xplanner.domain.Feature. Tiles targets all exist.

mobile-struts-config.xml (same module): /mobile/login (AuthenticationAction, forwards to wap/login.jsp, success redirect /do/mobile/view/projects) and DispatchForward views /mobile/view/projects, project, iteration, story, task, person -> WEB-INF/jsp/wap/*.jsp (projects via db:useBeans; task page db bean). View actions require projectId and read permission (DispatchForward default); requests without projectId go to the missing notAuthorized page. See the web-login precondition item.
GET /rest/view returns text/plain "Hi there!". Unauthenticated.

GET /rest/view/project/{projectId} returns ProjectView (id, name projection via ViewDaoImpl.getById criteria) as XML or JSON; unknown id -> null result. No authentication or permission check on /rest/*.

GET /rest/view/iteration/{iterationId}/userstories returns UserStoryView[] (priority, id, name, description, trackerId, estimated hours, order, status and task name/id/completed/description/created/original estimate/estimate/acceptor) as XML or JSON. Unauthenticated.

POST /rest/update/task/{taskId}/status with form fields status and originalEstimate (application/x-www-form-urlencoded; response XML/JSON Result{isError, code, description}): unknown task -> "Task not found"; same status -> "Task status not changed"; NON_STARTED -> "Moving Task to not started not implemented"; STARTED -> sets original estimate and completed=false; COMPLETED -> completed=true; saved via TaskDao -> "Task updated". Unauthenticated write.
items.limits: Result codes are constants in bytecode; exact numeric codes not decoded.

items.conditions_outcome: MePage returns view view/meStatus (meStatus.jsp) with the person (CommonDao) and their current active, pending and completed tasks, future tasks, stories as customer and as tracker, for any person id; linked from the page header for the logged-in person. Authenticated only.

CommonObjectHandler prints the path variable to stdout and returns it as the view name, resolved to /WEB-INF/jsp/{objectType}.jsp; no JSP exists at that top level, so these handlers have no useful page.
items.limits: Runtime behavior not observed (Stage 2 is source-only; live check belongs to Stage 3).

items.conditions_outcome: XPlanner service methods (BD-SOAP-OPS): get/add/remove/update for Project, Iteration, UserStory, Task, TimeEntry, Note, Person; getCurrentIteration(projectId), getIterations, getUserStories, getTasks, getTimeEntries, getNotesForObject, getPeople, getCurrentTasksForPerson, getPlannedTasksForPerson; set/get/delete attribute and getAttributes(WithPrefix). Reads return only objects with read permission (lists filtered, single get throws "no permission to read object"); update/remove/add check edit/delete/create on the owning project and throw AuthenticationException otherwise; changes record history (created/updated/deleted) and commit, errors roll back. Person-task queries return results through the same read filter (toArray -> selectAccessibleObjects); attribute operations perform no permission check.

items.surface: SOAP entry without the Basic filter
items.conditions_outcome: /servlet/AxisServlet is mapped to the same AxisServlet but no security filter covers it; SOAP permission checks call SecurityHelper.getRemoteUserId, which fails without a session subject, while attribute operations and Axis service listing/WSDL generation do not depend on it.
items.limits: Runtime behavior not observed (Stage 2 is source-only; live check belongs to Stage 3).

items.conditions_outcome: Requires a path of the form /{userId}.ics (else HttpServletResponse.sendError with "No iCal file requested." / "No .ics suffix"); a user may fetch their own calendar, or another user's when they have admin.edit on system.person for some project (else "No authorization for accessing calendar for ..."). Output (Content-type application/x-msoutlook, inline filename): VCALENDAR 1.0 with VTODO per incomplete non-overhead task accepted by the user (summary, categories project/iteration/story, percent complete, priority, URL /do/view/task?oid=) and VEVENT per time entry where the user is person1 or person2 (start/end); lines folded at 75 characters.

iterationStatistics.jsp renders Cewolf charts from IterationStatisticsQuery: task counts and estimated/actual hours by type and by disposition (pie charts with post-processors), velocity (TaskVelocityData, working days), burndown/progress from data samples (DataSampleData over estimatedHours/actualHours/remainingHours aspects, weekends optional); chart display flags and size from properties; xplanner.statistics=on shows the link.

Spring task scheduler (pool 10) runs missingTimeEntryNotifier.execute at cron "0 5 0 * * *" (00:05 daily, server time): computes midnight and the previous working reference date, emails each acceptor of tasks without time entries (named query TimeEntryEmailNotificationToAcceptors) when the project allows notification (project attribute or xplanner.project.send.notification), and emails project notification receivers a report (TimeEntryEmailNotificationToProjectSpecificLeads); messages from EmailResourceBundle/ResourceBundle job.emailnotifier.* via Velocity email_notifications.vm; send errors logged. Also triggerable via /do/edit/missingTimeEntryNotification.

DataSamplingCommand (transactional proxy) samples estimated, actual and remaining hours per iteration due between the previous and current sampling date (named query IterationToSample); samples saved in a new transaction (update existing or insert); extendIterationEndDateIfNeeded only when iteration.automatically.extend.endDate=true (false). Triggered on iteration start/close and by /do/edit/dataSample. A Quartz JobDetail (DataSamplingJob) and CronTrigger "0 55 23 ? 1-12 *" are declared, but the SchedulerFactoryBean is commented out, so no nightly sampling is scheduled.
items.limits: Absence of a scheduler for the CronTriggerBean follows from the XML; not observed.

items.conditions_outcome: task:executor "executor" (pool 10) has no consumer found; HsqlServer registers a JVM shutdown hook only when it starts a server; MissingTimeEntryEmailJob (Quartz bean class) is unreferenced.

MySQL via Connector/J 5.1.13; tables attribute, datasample, history, identifier, integration, iteration, note, notification_receivers, patches, permission, person, person_role, project, roles (renamed from role), story, task, time_entry, xdir, xfile, object_type, setting. Ids from HibernateIdentityGenerator (hi/lo on table identifier, column nextId).

Project 1-n Iteration (cascade ALL), Project 1-1 backlog (REMOVE), Project n-n Person notification_receivers, Iteration 1-n UserStory (REMOVE), UserStory n-1 customer Person (REFRESH), UserStory 1-n Task (REMOVE), Task 1-n TimeEntry ordered by reportDate (REMOVE), Note 1-1 File, File n-1 Directory, Directory tree (parent). Other references are plain integer ids (task.acceptorId, time_entry.person1Id/person2Id, story.trackerId, note.attachedToId, attribute.targetId, history.targetId, datasample.referenceId, person_role ids, permission.principal/resource_id) with no cascade.

Access paths: CommonDao (Session get/save/delete/flush), BaseDao subclasses (criteria, saveOrUpdate), legacy HibernateObjectRepository/RepositoryHistoryAdapter/RepositorySecurityAdapter, HibernateDaoSupport helpers, ThreadSession (classic Session.find/load), JSP db:useBean(s) HQL built from tag attributes, and raw JDBC (PersonTimesheetQuery, IdGenerator, HsqlServer SHUTDOWN). 29 named HQL queries in Metrics.xml (one more is commented out) (BD-NAMED-QUERIES). Queries are parameterized except where values are concatenated: AggregateTimesheetQuery person id list, DownloadAttachmentAction.locateNote (parsed int), OutlineTag sibling queries (ints), SOAP getObjects where clauses (constants and "attachedTo_Id = " + int), UseBeansTag where/order attributes from JSP source.

JavaMail messages (HTML body, optional file attachments, sent date) from EmailMessageImpl for task notifications, integration notifications and the daily job; recipient resolved from Person.email (missing email -> MessagingException "no email address for user"); CC list for integrations.

HttpClient.getPage (java.net.URL) fetches ${xplanner.application.url}/css/email.css to inline into every notification email; GenericWikiAdapter.isTopicExisting opens the configured wiki topic URL (http://localhost:9090/vqw/...) to decide whether a WikiWord is an existing or new topic while rendering wiki-formatted text.
items.limits: Runtime behavior not observed (Stage 2 is source-only; live check belongs to Stage 3).

items.conditions_outcome: jQuery 1.5.1, jQuery UI 1.8.11 (+custom CSS), dojo/dojox, overlib (tooltips, also used by Cewolf), swfobject with Dashboard.swf/expressInstall.swf, DHTML calendar with en/fr/it/ro and i18n JSP, nifty corners, tooltip.js, iteration.js, global.js, editTimeEntries.js, toggle.js, time.js.

db:useBeans (HQL "from <type> where <where> order by <order>" or named queries, cacheable, parameters from nested useBeansParameter) and db:useBean (Session.load of type attribute with id from attribute or request parameter oid) run during page rendering in 21 JSPs including the unauthenticated index.jsp and wap/login.jsp; AuthenticatedUserTag queries the current person; IsUserAuthorized* tags query projects; OutlineTag and NavigationBarTag load objects.

xplanner:twiki formats descriptions and notes (10 usages in 8 JSPs): TwikiFormat/radeox markup, scheme links (project/iteration/story/task links, external schemes), optional bracket escaping (project attribute), WikiWord links through the wiki adapter (HTTP probe per topic with GenericWikiAdapter).

18 JSP lines write values without HTML filtering (bean:write filter="false" or <%= request... %>), in generalError.jsp, continueUnfinishedStories.jsp, editIterationStatus.jsp, editNote.jsp, importPeople.jsp, moveContinueStory.jsp, moveContinueTask.jsp, viewLayout.jsp, viewLayoutNew.jsp, iterationStatistics.jsp and wap/auth.jsp (line numbers in BD-JSP).
items.limits: Whether each value is attacker-controlled is not established.

items.conditions_outcome: Request parameter returnto becomes the ActionForward path with redirect=true in EditObjectAction, DeleteObjectAction, DeleteNoteAction, EditProjectAction, MoveContinueStory/Task, ContinueUnfinishedStories, StartIteration, UpdateTimeAction, IdSearch, ChangeLocale, CommandExecutor, PutTheClockForward, EditProperties, CloseIteration; Struts prefixes the context path only for values starting with "/", so other values are sent as the Location. ViewObjectAction URL-encodes returnto into the display forward.
items.limits: Struts redirect handling is library behavior (unverified).

items.conditions_outcome: Parameter @type selects the domain class via Class.forName in AbstractAction.getObjectType when the mapping has no type (/do/view/history), and Continuer/OutlineTag links pass @type; JSP tag type attributes are compile-time.

With merge=true, EditObjectAction.populateObject applies RequestUtils.populate(domainObject, request), binding every request parameter name to a writable property of the persistent entity before save.
AggregateTimesheetForm selected people values are appended as strings into "AND person.id IN (...)" of the aggregate HQL query.
items.limits: Form property type conversion may constrain values (unverified).

items.surface: Global state changed by request values
items.conditions_outcome: propertyName/propertyValue -> XPlannerProperties.setProperty (all users, until restart); dayOffset -> TimeGenerator.moveCurrentDay (application "current day" for time-dependent queries and sampling); language -> session locale.

items.surface: Upload metadata to response headers and storage
items.conditions_outcome: Uploaded file name and content type (notes, file manager) are stored and later written into Content-disposition filename and Content-Type of downloads without transformation.

items.surface: Request data into the activity log
items.conditions_outcome: User id, client address, action and the complete query string of every /do request are written to xplanner-plus-activity.log in the web root (query strings may contain searched content, ids and returnto values).

items.surface: Path variable to Spring MVC view name
items.conditions_outcome: /setting/{objectType}/... returns objectType as the JSP view name (see Spring MVC handler item).

Reachable without login according to filter mappings and bypass lists: /index.jsp (project query and redirect), /calendar/calendar-i18n.jsp, all static files including /xplanner-plus-activity.log and any runtime log written to the web root, /files/*.xls, /rest/* (reads and the task-status write), /cewolf/*, /servlet/AxisServlet, /do/login, /do/notAuthorized, /do/invalidateHibernateCache, /do/mobile/login (then redirected), and the container error page with stack trace and system information for any failing request.
items.limits: Runtime behavior not observed (Stage 2 is source-only; live check belongs to Stage 3).

items.conditions_outcome: Human roles viewer, editor, admin, sysadmin (per project, project 0 = all) plus person-level functional roles: task acceptor, pair partner (time entry person2), story customer, story tracker, project notification receiver (lead), integration queue member; unauthenticated visitor; SOAP/iCal clients (Basic auth); REST clients (no auth); scheduler (system actor for daily emails); operator/test user of test actions.

items.surface: Spring dependency wiring of Struts action beans
items.conditions_outcome: action-servlet.xml and test-action-servlet.xml use default-autowire="byName" and lazy-init: each action bean receives beans whose id matches a setter (commonDao, eventBus, historySupport, authorizer, taskDao, userStoryDao, taskRepository, dataSampler, editPersonHelper, moveContinueStory, storyContinuer, taskContinuer, contentSearchHelper, idSearchHelper, transactionTemplate, ...) plus explicit properties (type, exporter, fileSystem, importer, task, timeGenerator, cacheMap, sessionFactory). Mechanical check of all 80 action beans against all bean ids found two unresolved object dependencies: ImportPeopleAction.personDao (no personDao bean is declared; PersonDaoImpl exists) and FileManagerAction.fileSystem (only /edit/note receives virtualFileSystem explicitly). Both fields are used without null checks, so /do/import/people saving and every /do/view/directory action would fail with a null dependency. IntegrationAction.beanFactory is supplied by BeanFactoryAware and its listener list is created in the constructor.
items.limits: Failure is inferred from missing bean definitions (positive control: taskDao/commonDao/eventBus resolve by name); not observed.

items.surface: Spring wiring of REST, MVC, security and mail components
items.conditions_outcome: Jersey resources ViewService/UpdateService are request-scoped @Component beans with @Autowired ViewManager/UpdateManager (spring-dao.xml); MePage/BasePage @Autowired CommonDao, TaskDao, UserStoryDao, TaskRepository from the root context; FormSecurityFilter/BasicSecurityFilter look up bean "authenticator" from the root context at init; AuthorizerInitializer (eager singleton) installs AuthorizerImpl as SystemAuthorizer; EmailNotificationSupport and MissingTimeEntryNotifier autowired by constructor; LoginModuleLoader autowired by type to the LoginModuleFactory beans.
